Martin is a first-year ELLIS PhD student at the <a href="https://aidos.group/">University of Fribourg (AIDOS Lab)</a> with supervision from <a href="https://bastian.rieck.me/">Prof. Bastian Rieck</a> and co-supervision by <a href="https://www2.compute.dtu.dk/~sohau/">Prof.Søren Hauberg</a>. 
His research interests are applications of graph theory, topology and geometry to machine learning. 
Currently he is working on studying metrics in the space of attributed graphs.
